title: Stealth aircraft: public RCS evidence
summary: Assess public RCS claims about the F-117, F-22, F-35 and B-2: 8 sourced Toulmin arguments, each with its evidence type, result, qualifier and the conditions that the source does not state. Actual DVIDS photographs, schematic outlines, an evidence matrix, and the NASA-funded F-117 aluminum model curves (figures 5.10 to 5.12 of NASA-CR-191378-VOL-4) extracted with their provenance and error, in dB with the reference not stated. No aircraft ranking and no RCS value for a service aircraft. Shareable view in the URL, JSON view files, a Markdown record and a narrated beamdswitch deck.
